label: x10-arm-check
_why: SMOKE TEST of the treatment arm's PLUMBING, not a measurement. {kind: control, config: ...} is a new setup shape (added 2026-08-06 so a vanilla control can carry a pop-need weight rescaling and nothing else). Its first real use is run 19 of vanilla_retest, ~7 h into an overnight batch - which is the worst possible place to discover that Resolve-Setup drops the -Config argument. One minute here buys that.
_check: PASS = build_state.json records arm 'control+pop_needs' with deviates_from_vanilla ['common/pop_needs'], and the emitted 00_pop_needs.txt differs from vanilla in exactly 4 weight lines.
